rituals.title: Intention Setting
rituals.opening: The dark moon is the empty page. Nothing is required of you yet.
steps: Sit somewhere you will not be interrupted for ten minutes.
Write down one thing you want, in the present tense, as though it is already true.
Underneath it, write the smallest action that would make it slightly more true.
Do that action within 48 hours. That is the whole ritual.

rituals.title: Release
rituals.opening: Everything is lit, including what you would rather not look at.
steps: Name one thing you are ready to stop carrying.
Write it down in full. Do not abbreviate it to be polite.
Read it aloud once, to yourself.
Tear the page. Keeping it is also allowed — the point is the naming.

rituals.title: Meeting Resistance
rituals.opening: The half-lit moon is where the friction shows up.
steps: Name what has become harder than you expected.
Ask whether it is difficult or simply unfamiliar.
Choose one thing to make 10% easier, and change it today.

rituals.title: Honest Review
rituals.opening: Before the dark, an accounting. No punishment involved.
steps: List three things that happened this cycle. Any three.
Mark which you would repeat.
Forgive yourself one specific thing, by name.

rituals.title: Beginning Again
rituals.opening: Nothing has started yet. That is the advantage.
steps: Think of something you began once and abandoned.
Write down what stopped it — the real reason, not the tidy one.
Decide whether that reason is still true.
If it is not, begin again this week. If it is, put it down on purpose rather than by default.

rituals.title: The Small Yes
rituals.opening: The dark moon asks for a direction, not a plan.
steps: Name one thing you have been saying no to out of habit.
Say yes to a small version of it — an hour, a message, one attempt.
Choose the day now, before this moon is visible again.

rituals.title: Full Light
rituals.opening: The moon is holding nothing back tonight. Match it.
steps: Name one thing that is going well. Say it without qualifying it.
Write down who helped, if anyone did.
Tell them. One sentence is enough.

rituals.title: The Unsaid Thing
rituals.opening: Everything is lit. What you are avoiding is lit too.
steps: Name the sentence you keep rehearsing and not saying.
Write it exactly as you would say it out loud.
Choose one: you will say it this cycle, or you are choosing not to.
Both are decisions. Only one of them is yours so far.

rituals.title: Halfway
rituals.opening: Half lit, half not. This is where things get abandoned.
steps: Name what you started at the new moon.
Say honestly how far it actually got.
Do the smallest next piece of it today, even badly.

rituals.title: The Cost
rituals.opening: Something is asking more of you than you expected.
steps: Name what it is costing — time, money, attention, sleep.
Decide whether you are still willing to pay it.
If you are, say so plainly. If you are not, stop paying rather than resenting it.

rituals.title: Winding Down
rituals.opening: The light is going. Nothing needs finishing tonight.
steps: List what you are still carrying from this cycle.
Cross off anything that was never yours.
Choose one thing to finish before the dark. Let the rest wait.

rituals.title: What It Taught You
rituals.opening: Before the dark, one honest sentence.
steps: Finish this: “This cycle showed me…”
Do not soften it.
Keep it. Read it again at the next last quarter.
